provenance.notes: QA independently fetched only the depth-one pre-fix commit, removed the remote, and applied the supplied format patch. Recreating the commit with the patch-declared parent, tree, author, date, identity, and message produced the exact result revision. No accepted fix, upstream PR, current branch, later history, or audit data was inspected.

acceptanceCriteria.details: Long options ending in three or four hyphens parse as named options, including an assigned value. Bare -, end-of-options --, ordinary dashed names, and empty invalid option spellings retain their specified behavior.

tests.details: Focused regression: 2 passed. CommonJS suite: 357 passed. ESM suite: 17 passed. TypeScript suite: 20 passed. No failures.

regressions.details: Independent assertions covered empty assigned values, internal triple-hyphen sequences, bare - and --, three-or-more-hyphen empty names, ordinary dashed options, and unknown-options-as-args mode. The configured unknown option remains positional as intended.

explainability.details: The one-character implementation change directly addresses the defect: anchoring the empty-option regular expression prevents a trailing --- sequence in a valid name from matching while retaining the normalized leading-empty-name guard.

prReadiness.details: The patch is narrowly scoped, has focused neighboring-case coverage, applies cleanly, reconstructs the exact frozen revision, passes all requested suites and lint, and documents historical installation constraints.

build.details: npm run pretest completed TypeScript compilation and the Rollup CommonJS build. Rollup emitted only its existing built-in-module externalization notices.

lint.details: npm run check passed StandardX over TypeScript, JavaScript, and CommonJS files. git diff --check passed.

typecheck.details: The pretest TypeScript compile passed and the repository's TypeScript behavioral suite passed 20 tests with the documented installation-only TypeScript 4.5.5 and @types/node 16.11.4 pins.

limitations: Node.js 24.19.0 on Linux only; the historical Node matrix was not run.
Historical unconstrained dependency ranges required installation-only TypeScript 4.5.5 and @types/node 16.11.4 pins; tracked manifests remained unchanged.
Puppeteer's browser download and npm run test:browser were not run; browser behavior is unrelated to the parser branch changed here.
